title: System Drive Solution Leader
desc:
About the Role
At Schneider Electric, we are looking for an experienced and results-driven
System Drive Solution Leader
to accelerate the growth of our Drive Systems business in Türkiye and strengthen our position across key industrial market segments.
In this role, you will lead the development and positioning of
Drive System solutions
, combining strong technical expertise with a commercial and customer-focused mindset. You will work closely with
end users, consultants, EPCs, OEMs, system integrators, contractors, and strategic partners
to understand complex industrial requirements and develop competitive, high-value solutions.
You will leverage your expertise in
drive systems, industrial automation, digital transformation, and Industry 4.0
to identify customer challenges, shape solution architectures, influence project specifications, and position Schneider Electric’s capabilities from the early stages of an opportunity.
Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and Project Execution teams, you will provide
technical and commercial leadership throughout the complete opportunity lifecycle
, from opportunity identification and solution definition to proposal development, negotiation, contract award, and successful project handover.
Job Description
Lead the development and growth of
System Drive solutions
across relevant industrial applications and market segments in Türkiye.
Identify and develop high-potential customers, applications, projects, and business opportunities for Drive Systems.
Act as a
solution leader and trusted advisor
for customers, providing technical and commercial guidance throughout the opportunity lifecycle.
Engage with customers at an early stage to understand their operational, technical, and commercial requirements and translate them into effective
Drive System architectures and solutions
.
Build and strengthen strategic relationships with
end users, consultants, EPCs, OEMs, system integrators, contractors, and other key industry stakeholders
.
Lead technical discussions, solution presentations, system architecture reviews, and value proposition development for complex Drive System opportunities.
Influence project specifications and support customers and partners in defining the most appropriate technical solutions for their applications.
Position Schneider Electric’s Drive Systems portfolio through
consultative selling, technical expertise, value-based solution discussions, and commercial negotiations
.
Translate complex customer requirements and industrial challenges into compelling and competitive
technical and commercial value propositions
.
Lead opportunities throughout the complete sales cycle, including
qualification, specification, solution design, tendering, proposal development, negotiation, contract award, and project handover
.
Collaborate closely with
Sales, Marketing, Engineering, and Project Execution teams
to ensure technical feasibility, commercial competitiveness, and customer satisfaction.
Support the development of strategic partner and system integrator networks to expand market coverage and solution capabilities.
Drive the adoption of innovative Drive System technologies, digital solutions, and Industry 4.0 concepts across relevant industrial applications.
Monitor market trends, customer needs, competitive activities, and emerging technologies to identify new solution and growth opportunities.
Contribute to the overall
Drive Systems strategy, business development initiatives, and growth objectives
in Türkiye.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in
Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Automation Engineering
, or a related engineering field.
Minimum 8 years of professional experience in Drive Systems, Industrial Automation, Technical Sales, Solution Engineering, Business Development, or a related industrial field.
Strong technical knowledge of
Drive Systems, variable speed drives, industrial automation, and industrial applications
.
Proven ability to understand complex customer requirements and develop
integrated system-level technical solutions
.
Experience in
solution selling, project business, technical-commercial proposal development, and complex industrial projects
.
Strong understanding of customer applications and the ability to translate technical requirements into competitive and value-driven solutions.
Experience working with
end users, OEMs, EPCs, system integrators, consultants, and strategic business partners
.
Good understanding of
digital transformation and Industry 4.0
concepts within industrial environments.
Strong
technical-commercial mindset
, with the ability to balance solution performance, customer value, and business objectives.
Demonstrated ability to influence project specifications and engage effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders.
Excellent
communication, presentation, negotiation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills
.
Ability to lead complex opportunities while collaborating effectively within cross-functional and matrix organizations.
Proactive, customer-oriented, and results-driven mindset with strong ownership.
Fluent in Turkish and English.
